modes.description: A blank or 'within' just before a number that will be followed by a short time unit.

modes.description: The '/kg' in an infusion rate written as mg/kg, where '/h' or '/min' comes next.

modes.label: Every before an interval
modes.description: The word 'every' or 'at least every' before a short repeating interval.
